Who we are

We understand construction, engineering, projects and business.

Prodigy Construction Limited is a professional construction and engineering company serving clients in Kenya and across East Africa. Our role is to turn complex requirements into well-managed, buildable outcomes.

Government & county institutions

Vision

To become a leading construction and engineering company recognised for excellence, innovation, integrity and sustainable development.

Mission

To deliver quality construction and infrastructure solutions that exceed client expectations while creating lasting stakeholder value.
